limits: Labels are distilled from Gemini, so the fine-tuned model inherits Gemini's judgement calls and mistakes; only the held-out test set was checked by hand.
The test set is small (about 150 postings), so differences of a few points between models are within noise.
Postings are English-language remote/tech roles drawn from a limited set of sources; other industries, languages and formats are untested.
Postings longer than 6,000 characters are truncated before extraction.
Salary is extracted as stated, with no currency conversion or annualisation.
